items.text:
I can't say I enjoyed playing as Julian's motor functions, but I was distinctly uncomfortable any time his low-poly hands came near the screen because I didn't like his voice and didn't want him near me. Spent most of my time avoiding the leaning forward action that prompted this disgust response, until I realized you don't actually need to press any buttons for most of it to continue the dialogue. Until the cigarettes, if I waited long enough he would just go through with whatever the suggested action was anyway.

It's also very clear the reason Julian was stood up on his dinner date is because when he's not thinking about sleeping with 20-year-olds, he's busy making the most godawful slurping sounds while eating bread and congratulating himself on his tapenade.
items.text_zh:
我不能说我享受扮演朱利安的运动功能，但每当他那低多边形的手靠近屏幕时，我都明显感到不舒服，因为我不喜欢他的声音，也不想让他靠近我。我大部分时间都在避免那个会引发这种厌恶反应的前倾动作，直到我意识到大部分情况下你其实不需要按任何按钮就能继续对话。直到香烟那里，如果我等得够久，他反正就会直接去做那个建议的动作。

同样很明显，朱利安在晚餐约会中被放鸽子的原因，是因为当他不想着和20岁的人上床时，他就忙着在吃面包时发出最可怕的吸溜声，并自我祝贺他的橄榄酱。

observations.description: 吃面包时发出难听的咂嘴声
observations.evidence: the most godawful slurping sounds while eating bread
